content:
{'i': '[0] 我最近試咗一連串睇落比較似傳統銀包嘅新款 MagSafe 銀包，Vinich 嘅 MagSafe 銀包係我最新試嘅一款。佢提供超過 15 種顏色選擇，設計睇落似傳統嘅摺疊式銀包，可以貼喺皮革 iPhone 手機殼背面而唔會撞色，畀人感覺係 iPhone 手機殼嘅延伸。', 'translation': "I've recently been testing a number of new MagSafe wallets that look more like traditional wallets, and the Vinich MagSafe wallet is the latest one I've tried. It comes in more than 15 color options, is designed to look like a traditional bifold wallet, and can attach to the back of a leather iPhone case without clashing, giving the impression of being an extension of the iPhone case itself."}

{'i': '[1] MagSafe Monday：每個星期一，Bradley Chambers 都會同大家睇下 MagSafe 同無線充電行業嘅最新、最強產品，幫你盡情發揮支援無線充電嘅 Apple 裝置嘅威力。', 'translation': 'MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers brings you the newest and best products from the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless-charging-enabled Apple devices.'}

{'i': '[2] 顏色選擇', 'translation': 'Color Options'}

{'i': '[3] 廠商喺顏色方面明顯想做到應有盡有，除咗黑色、綠色、啡色，仲有紫色，全部都帶有使用過嘅復古感覺，同皮革手機殼襯得起而唔會搶風頭。仲有數之不盡嘅其他顏色。Vinich 亦提供沙漠鈦色，如果你唔用保護殼想直接展示 iPhone 嘅原色，呢個顏色會好夾。', 'translation': "The manufacturer clearly wanted to offer something for everyone when it comes to colors. In addition to black, green, and brown, there's also purple, all featuring a vintage, well-worn look that complements a leather case without stealing the spotlight. There are countless other colors to choose from as well. Vinich also offers a Desert Titanium shade, which pairs beautifully if you want to show off your iPhone's original finish without a case."}

{'i': '[4] 銀包收納', 'translation': 'Wallet Storage'}

{'i': '[5] Vinich 列明設有三個卡槽，並指出視乎卡片厚度，實際可以放入三至五張卡。日常使用嘅話，可能會放駕駛執、一兩張卡同一張公司門禁卡。卡後面仲有空間可以摺埋一兩張紙幣，對於呢個尺寸嘅銀包嚟講我覺得相當重要。我會盡量隨身帶住大約 20 美元備用。', 'translation': "Vinich states that the wallet has three card slots and notes that depending on card thickness, it can actually hold three to five cards. For everyday use, you might keep your driver's license, one or two cards, and a work access card. There's also space behind the cards to fold one or two bills, which I think is quite important for a wallet of this size. I try to always carry about $20 in cash as a backup."}

{'i': '[6] 卡槽內層採用咗 RFID 屏蔽物料，內部就鋪上超細纖維，令你張卡全日都唔會直接磨住布料。磁力方面夠用，雖然我用過磁力更強嘅，亦都用過弱好多嘅。', 'translation': "The interior of the card slots uses RFID-blocking material, and the inside is lined with microfiber so your cards don't rub directly against fabric all day. The magnet is strong enough, though I've used ones that were stronger and ones that were much weaker."}

{'i': '[7] 購買前必須知嘅三件事', 'translation': 'Three Things to Know Before You Buy'}

{'i': '[8] 第一，呢款係合成皮，唔係真皮。佢有防刮設計同加固縫線，呢個價位嘅貨色理應如此，但如果你打算同真皮手機殼配襯，就要預先知道兩者嘅材質唔會完全一致。Vinich 建議每三至六個月做一次護理保養。', 'translation': "First, this is made of synthetic leather, not genuine leather. It features scratch-resistant design and reinforced stitching, which is to be expected at this price point, but if you're planning to pair it with a genuine leather case, you should know in advance that the materials won't be an exact match. Vinich recommends conditioning it every three to six months."}

{'i': '[9] 第二，喺影超廣角同微距相嘅時候，佢可能會慢慢移入鏡頭範圍。喺大部分 iPhone 上，銀包位置都低過鏡頭，但如果影近距離相嘅話，最好除咗佢先影，確保完全冇遮住鏡頭。', 'translation': "Second, when taking ultra-wide and macro photos, it can slowly creep into the frame. On most iPhones, the wallet sits below the camera, but if you're shooting close-up shots, it's best to remove it first to make sure it doesn't obstruct the lens at all."}

{'i': '[10] 最後，佢雖然睇落好似可以充當支架，但其實唔可以。銀包嘅蓋特意設計得比較柔軟，等磁吸圈唔會承受太大壓力，所以如果你想搵一款可以撐起 iPhone 用嚟打電話或者睇片嘅銀包，呢款就唔啱你。', 'translation': "Finally, although it may look like it could function as a stand, it can't. The wallet's flap is intentionally designed to be relatively soft so the magnetic ring doesn't bear too much pressure, so if you're looking for a wallet that can prop up your iPhone for calls or watching videos, this one isn't for you."}

{'i': '[11] 總結', 'translation': 'Wrap-up'}

{'i': '[12] 25 美元以下嘅價位，如果你用緊靚皮革手機殼但嫌個銀包襯唔到，單係顏色選擇已經值得考慮。大部分 MagSafe 銀包都設計到等佢隱形，但呢一款係設計嚟同其他嘢配襯，睇落同手感都更加似一款可以單獨拎出嚟用嘅傳統銀包。日後如果可以加入 Find Me 追蹤功能就更加完美。', 'translation': "At under $25, if you're using a nice leather case and feel your wallet doesn't quite match, the color options alone make this worth considering. Most MagSafe wallets are designed to blend in, but this one is made to complement other items, and both its look and feel are more like a traditional wallet you could pull out and use on its own. Adding Find My tracking functionality down the road would make it perfect."}

{'i': '[13] 你可以喺 Amazon 或者直接喺 Vinich 官網買到呢款 Vinich MagSafe 銀包。', 'translation': "You can purchase this Vinich MagSafe wallet on Amazon or directly from Vinich's website."}
